process_description: Infosys recruitment process includes an online aptitude test (InfyTQ certification preferred), technical interview covering DSA and OOPS, and HR interview. Process is 1-day on campus.
TCS recruitment consists of TCS NQT (National Qualifier Test) online, followed by technical and managerial interviews for shortlisted candidates.
Wipro recruitment includes an aptitude test (NLTH test), technical test, technical interview, and HR round. Dress code is formals.
HCL recruitment includes online aptitude, technical interview, and HR round. Offers graduate engineer trainee roles.
Cognizant GenC programme includes aptitude, coding test, technical interview, and HR interview. Programming knowledge in Java or Python required.
